subject.title: fix(memory): increase QMD embedTimeoutMs default to 600s for local GG…

question: Should this PR require real QMD/GGUF runtime proof before accepting the broad 600s default, or should a maintainer override proof and accept the default/lock-wait tradeoff?
rationale: Automation can verify the source-level timeout path, but it cannot decide whether grep/test evidence is enough for a compatibility-sensitive runtime default affecting existing unset QMD users.

options.title: Require runtime proof
options.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing a real QMD/GGUF embed completing under the unset 600s default before merge.

options.title: Override proof and accept
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly accept the proof gap and the longer default/lock-wait behavior as the intended product tradeoff.

options.title: Narrow the change
options.body: Pause this broad default change and pursue a selective local-GGUF strategy or warning/docs-only improvement instead.

recommendation.title: Require runtime proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted logs, terminal output, or a linked artifact showing a real QMD/GGUF embed completing under the unset 600s default before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: osolmaz is the live assignee and recently changed QMD config/search behavior on the same surfaces.
